profTagline: Record two seconds of the world — a door, a cup, rain, your own voice — and play it. Grain slices the take into short windowed grains and streams them back as a cloud you strike on eight fields, tuned to your scale: the recording itself is the root, so an unpitched slam works like a struck bowl and is never given a note it does not have. Tilt bends grain size and tone, Flow writes a phrase, and what you hear exports as a WAV. Recorded and processed on your device, offline.
